up: For CHEMBL4282 (human RAC-alpha serine/threonine-protein kinase), return compounds that have IC50 activities with units of nM. For each matching compound-activity pair, return the compound's canonical SMILES, the compound key from the compound record, the assay description, and the target name. Also provide the PubMed ID or DOI for the document associated with the activity. Return one row per activity record, including all available matches.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4282'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM';
